question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "**on**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given passage, the correct preposition for blank 4 is "on." 
 
• "On" is the correct preposition to use when referring to something being placed or situated on top of something else.(पर)
 
 
• Example: The book is on the table.
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, **to be dependent on something or someone means to need them in order to succeed or be able to survive.**

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, "to", is a preposition used to indicate direction or movement towards something/someone. (तक)
 
• Option 3, "in", is a preposition used to indicate being inside or within something/someone.(में)
 
• Option 4, "of", is a preposition used to indicate possession or relationship between two things. (का)
